text.p: The attack on the main Jewish street market in Jerusalem dominated Israeli newspapers on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
JERUSALEM POST
- 13 killed in Jerusalem blast. Hamas claims market attack.
- Government suspends talks with Palestinian Authority, demands more intensive fight against terrorism.
- Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's economics adviser Moshe Leon: We'll meet 1997 deficit goal.
- Galileo Technology Ltd soars 55 percent on first day.
- New Israel Lands Administration chief: Building sales lag behind 1997 target.
GLOBES
- 11 killed and about 150 wounded in Mahane Yehuda attack.
- Nervous trading in foreign currency following attack.
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Inferno in the market.

- Israel imposes sanctions on Palestinians: Negotiations to be halted completely until complete removal of terror; Hundreds of Hamas and Islamic Jihad militants must be arrested and 'terrorists' handed over to Israel; Appeal to U.S. and donor countries to halt aid to Palestinians; Limits on passage of Palestinian VIPs from Gaza to West Bank.

- In commentaries, military commentator Ron Ben-Yishai writes: "Hamas to blame, Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat responsible" and Nahum Barnea writes: "For 100 years we've managed to stand firm. That's our real security -- our own self-confidence. With all the fury, with all the sorrow, two villains who chose to commit suicide in the middle of the market mustn't undermine our security."
- Labour minister demands government set unemployment target for 1998.
- Stock exchange: Rates drop more than one percent following the attack.
MAARIV
- Inferno in Mahane Yehuda. Increased preparedness for fear of further attacks.

- Author David Grossman: "It seems to me the latest blast requires us to recognise reality for what it is: Israel and the Palestinians alone are incapable any longer of reaching an agreement on their own that will ensure true peace. They are captives to their history and psychology, and have lost the ability to escape it. If anyone in the world still cares what is happening here, it is better that he do something to force the leaders of the sides to begin to talk seriously. The American style of 'letting the sides mature on their own' has proven to be ineffective when speaking of two peoples with our suicidal tendencies. Now what's essential is decisive outside pressure on the two sides, and mainly on Israel which holds most of the cards in its hands."

- Commentator Chemi Shalev: The attack now transfers American attention from the Israeli construction in Jerusalem and territories to terrorism in the Palestinian Authority areas, delaying the Israeli confrontation with Washington.
- Knesset decides on mandatory insurance competition in another two years.
HAARETZ
- 13 killed in double suicide attack in heart of Jerusalem.
- Military correspondent Zeev Schiff: Islamic Jihad receives payment from Iran for every attack.
- "Members of Knesset buy by phone and leave the terrorism to the poor," says seller in market.
- Hamas threatens wave of attacks, demands release of founder Sheikh Ahmed Yassin.

- Editorial: "No political dispute or religious disagreement justifies or excuses the murder of 11 citizens and the wounding of dozens, including women and children, in the Mahane Yehuda market in Jerusalem. It is clear that no policy, or regime, immunizes the citizens of Israel from Palestinian suicide attackers sent to sow murder and terror in the population centres of Israel."
